models.name: hrm_time_tracking_owners
models.description:
Organization owner account identities with email/password credentials and account lifecycle metadata.

This table stores the global authenticated identity for owner actors in the HRM time tracking platform. It is intentionally limited to credential and account-state information and does not duplicate organization membership, workspace selection, or profile presentation data.

Owner-specific login sessions are stored in {@link hrm_time_tracking_owner_sessions}, and password recovery records are stored in {@link hrm_time_tracking_owner_password_resets}. Organization-scoped workforce and tenant relationships are modeled in other components rather than this actor table.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the owner account login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authenticating the owner account.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login for the owner account.

plainFields.name: deactivated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the owner account was deactivated from active use while preserving historical references.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the owner account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the owner account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of the owner account.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for organization owner accounts.

This table stores each owner login session together with connection metadata, expiry time, and the currently selected organization context used to scope requests in the multi-tenant ERP platform. It belongs to {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners} and references the active organization workspace through {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations}, allowing owners to work within a selected tenant context during a session.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner account that owns this session. {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Currently selected organization context for this session. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the owner session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Application URL associated with the session creation context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_password_resets
models.description:
One-time password reset requests for organization owner accounts.

This table stores reset tokens issued to {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners} together with expiration and consumption tracking so password recovery can be securely validated and audited. Multiple reset requests may exist for the same owner over time, but each token is unique and may be consumed only once.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner account that requested the password reset. {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token issued to validate a password recovery request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the password reset token is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was consumed. Null means the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this password reset record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_managers
models.description:
Authenticated manager account records for the HRM time tracking platform.

This actor table stores the login identity and credential state for manager users who can access organization-scoped management features through separate session records. It intentionally contains only core authentication and lifecycle fields, while organization membership, employee business records, role assignment, profile data, active organization context, password reset flows, and sessions are handled by other dedicated tables such as session, human resources, and profile-related models.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the manager account sign-in identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authenticating the manager account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the manager account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the manager account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp set when the manager account is deleted or deactivated from authentication use.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_sessions
models.description:
Login session records for authenticated manager accounts.

This table stores connection context and session lifetime information for {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers} authentication events. Each record belongs to exactly one manager account and supports auditability and session expiration handling within the HRM time-tracking platform.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated manager account's {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the manager session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Application URL associated with the session creation request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded when the manager session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the manager session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the manager session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_password_resets
models.description:
One-time password reset requests issued for {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers} accounts.

This table stores reset token values, expiration timing, and consumption state for manager password recovery flows. Each record belongs to exactly one manager account and preserves auditability for issued and consumed reset requests without duplicating manager identity data.

The model supports secure password reset processing by enforcing unique token values, tracking expiry deadlines, and recording when a token has been used. Multiple reset requests may exist for the same manager over time.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_id
foreignFields.description: Manager account that owns this password reset request. {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token value issued to prove control of the reset flow.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the password reset token is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was used successfully. Null means the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset request was issued.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of this password reset record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employees
models.description:
Authenticated employee account identities for the HRM time tracking platform.

This actor table stores the login credentials and global authentication state used when an employee signs in with email and password. It is the parent identity record for employee authentication flows and is referenced by employee session and password reset records.

This table intentionally excludes organization-scoped workforce attributes such as department, role assignment, employment type, and employee status because those belong to the human-resources domain model rather than the authentication boundary. It also excludes active organization context because that state belongs to session records, not the root actor identity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used by the employee to sign in.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for employee authentication.

plainFields.name: email_verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee email address was verified.

plainFields.name: last_logged_in_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the employee's most recent successful sign-in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for this employee account.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_sessions
models.description:
Login sessions for authenticated employee accounts.

This table records each employee sign-in event together with connection metadata, the currently selected organization workspace, session expiration, and logout state. It belongs to {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} and may reference the active organization context in {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations} so multi-organization users can work within one selected tenant during a session.

The model is used by authentication and authorization flows rather than standalone business management. Session rows preserve auditability for login history and support explicit logout control without denormalizing employee or organization attributes into the session record.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated employee account's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Currently selected organization workspace's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the employee session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Application URL from which the employee initiated the authenticated session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer captured at login time for audit and security review.

plainFields.name: logged_out_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was explicitly logged out. Null means the session has not been explicitly terminated yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee session becomes invalid and must no longer be accepted.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_password_resets
models.description:
One-time password reset requests for {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} accounts.

This table stores issued reset tokens, their expiration deadlines, and whether the token has already been consumed. It supports employee account recovery flows while preserving a historical record of reset issuance and usage for security review and operational auditing.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee account that owns this reset request. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token issued to prove reset authorization.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was consumed. Null means the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the reset token is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was last updated.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_organizations
models.description:
Organization tenant records for the multi-tenant HRM and time-tracking platform.

This table stores the core organization identity and settings used as the parent scope for workforce administration, projects, time tracking, reporting, and other organization-isolated business data. Each record represents one independently operated tenant with its own operational preferences such as display information, currency, timezone, and fiscal calendar configuration.

Other organization-scoped tables reference this model as their parent context, including {@link hrm_time_tracking_organization_invitations}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_departments}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs}, and {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets}. The table intentionally stores only atomic tenant settings and avoids denormalized workflow or aggregate data.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name shown throughout the workspace and used to identify the tenant to its members.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional summary describing the organization's purpose, business context, or internal notes for presentation.

plainFields.name: logo_uri
plainFields.description: Optional URI of the organization's logo image used in workspace branding and visual identification.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Default currency code used by the organization for financial values and compensation display, such as USD, EUR, or KRW.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier that defines the organization's local operating time context, such as Asia/Seoul.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month number from 1 to 12 indicating when the organization's fiscal year starts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the organization record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the organization record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the organization was soft deleted. Null means the organization is active.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_invitations
models.description:
Organization-scoped invitation records used to add an existing or future user to an organization membership flow.

Each record represents one invitation sent to an email address for a specific organization and optionally preselects the role that should be assigned when the invitation is accepted. The table preserves invitation lifecycle state such as pending, accepted, expired, or cancelled without denormalizing organization or role data.

This model belongs to {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations} and may reference {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles} for the intended organization-scoped role. It supports administrative invitation lists, onboarding reconciliation by email, and audit-friendly lifecycle timestamps.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Target organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_id
foreignFields.description: Intended organization role's {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id} to assign when the invitation is accepted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Invitee email address used to match an existing account or a future signup.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Invitation lifecycle status such as pending, accepted, expired, or cancelled.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Optional invitation message or note shown to the invited person.

plainFields.name: invited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was issued to the email address.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invited user accepted the invitation.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was resolved into a completed organization membership outcome.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation expires or was marked expired.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was cancelled by an administrator.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of this invitation record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_roles
models.description:
Organization-scoped role definitions used to classify employee authority within a single tenant organization.

This table stores both built-in roles and custom roles for {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations}. It provides the canonical role identity assigned to workforce records in {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees}, while the normalized permission set for each role is stored separately in the existing {@link hrm_time_tracking_role_permissions} table. Built-in roles distinguish platform-defined roles such as Owner, Manager, and Employee from organization-defined custom roles.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the role within the organization, such as Owner, Manager, Employee, or a custom role name.

plainFields.name: built_in
plainFields.description: Whether the role is a platform-provided built-in role rather than an organization-defined custom role.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the role record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the role record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the role record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_permissions
models.description:
Normalized permission assignments for organization-scoped roles.

Each record grants one allowed permission code to one {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles} record, ensuring the role permission set is stored in First Normal Form rather than as an array or JSON payload.

These rows are managed as supporting configuration data for role administration within an organization. Organization scope is inherited through the related role, so this table does not duplicate tenant identifiers or role metadata.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_id
foreignFields.description: Related role's {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description: Granted permission code for the related role, such as org:manage, employee:manage, project:view, time:approve, or report:view.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was soft deleted.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_departments
models.description:
Organization-scoped departments used to structure employees within a tenant.

Each department belongs to one {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations} record and may optionally reference one parent department to support a single level of hierarchy. Departments are referenced by employee workforce records but do not own employee data directly, allowing employee references to be cleared if a department is removed.

This table stores only raw department attributes and hierarchy linkage, keeping organization and employee details normalized in their own tables.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this department. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_department_id
foreignFields.description: Parent department for one-level hierarchy. {@link hrm_time_tracking_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name displayed within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional explanation of the department's purpose or scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the department record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the department record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the department was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_contracts
models.description:
Historical employment contract records for workforce members within an organization.

Each record stores the terms of employment for one employee, including its effective date range, compensation basis, and expected weekly working hours. Contracts belong to {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} and preserve historical employment terms without duplicating organization or user identity data.

This table supports current and past contract tracking, including ongoing contracts with no end date, while leaving overlap and active-contract exclusivity validation to service logic.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Contract effective start date and time boundary.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Contract effective end date and time boundary. Null means the contract is ongoing.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Numeric compensation rate defined by the contract.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Compensation basis classification such as hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Expected working hours per week defined by the contract.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional administrative notes about the contract terms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this contract record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this contract record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means the contract record is active in storage.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_projects
models.description:
Projects within an organization, storing the core identity, display settings, lifecycle state, and optional planning fields used for work execution.

Each project belongs to exactly one organization through {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id} and serves as the parent record for project memberships, tasks, and time-tracking records managed in other tables. This table stores only normalized source attributes for the project itself and intentionally excludes derived reporting values such as actual logged hours or budget utilization percentages.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this project. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Project name used by organization members to identify and browse the project.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer explanation of the project's scope, goals, or internal notes.

plainFields.name: color_code
plainFields.description: Required UI display color code used to visually distinguish the project in the interface.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the project. Allowed business values are active, archived, and completed.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimated total budgeted hours planned for the project.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned or actual project start date.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned or actual project end date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion when the project is logically removed from active use.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_memberships
models.description:
Project assignment records connecting employees to projects.

This table stores the organization-scoped membership of one employee in one project through references to {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects} and {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees}. It captures the project-specific responsibility classification used by the business domain, such as standard member or project-lead, without duplicating project, employee, or organization attributes.

Each row represents one unique employee-to-project assignment. Duplicate assignments for the same employee within the same project are prevented by a composite unique constraint. Soft deletion allows assignments to be removed from active use while preserving historical references and auditability.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: membership_role
plainFields.description: Project-specific responsibility classification for the assignment, such as member or project-lead.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this project membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this project membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this project membership was soft deleted, if it is no longer active.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_tasks
models.description:
Tasks defined within a project and managed as the core unit of work execution.

Each task belongs to one {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects} record, may be assigned to one {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} workforce record, and may optionally reference one parent task for a single level of subtask nesting. The table stores the mutable operational state used for task boards, filtering, sorting, and assignment workflows.

Historical status transitions are preserved separately in {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories}, so this table keeps only the current task state and raw business attributes without duplicating audit records or denormalized project or employee data.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project containing this task. {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee assigned to perform this task when an assignee has been selected. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task for one-level subtask nesting. {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short task title displayed in task lists and project boards.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed explanation of the work to be completed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status of the task. Allowed business values are open, in-progress, completed, and closed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority classification used for sorting and planning. Allowed business values are low, medium, high, and urgent.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimated effort for the task measured in hours.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional deadline for completing the task.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion when the task is removed from active use.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_histories
models.description:
Historical audit records for task status transitions within a project task lifecycle.

Each row captures one status change event for a single {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks} record, including the previous status, the new status, the actor category that performed the change, and the business timestamp when the transition occurred. This table is append-oriented and preserves workflow history without duplicating task, project, or user profile data.

Concrete actor ownership is intentionally normalized through dedicated subtype tables rather than multiple nullable foreign keys on this table, so the status-change actor can be linked to the correct existing actor model while remaining compliant with the required polymorphic ownership pattern.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: Task whose status changed. {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Category of actor who performed the status change. Expected business values are owner, manager, or employee.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: Task status value before the transition was applied.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Task status value after the transition was applied.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Business timestamp when the task status transition was made.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this audit record when it is logically removed.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_of_owners
models.description:
Subtype record that links a task status history entry to the owner account that performed the change.

This table normalizes actor ownership for {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories} when the status transition was made by an owner, avoiding invalid polymorphic nullable foreign keys on the parent history table. Each row belongs to exactly one task history record and one existing {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners} account.

The relationship to the task history table is one-to-one so a history entry can resolve to at most one owner subtype record. The relationship to the owner table is many-to-one because an owner may author many task status changes across organizations and projects.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_id
foreignFields.description: Linked task status history record. {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner account that performed the task status change. {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this owner subtype link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this owner subtype link was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this owner subtype link was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_of_managers
models.description:
Subtype record that links a task status history entry to the manager actor who performed the status change.

This table exists to normalize polymorphic actor ownership for {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories} without placing multiple nullable actor foreign keys on the parent history table. Each row identifies the manager responsible for a specific task history entry, while manager identity data remains in {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers} and history event data remains in {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories}.

A task history entry can have at most one manager subtype row in this table, making the relationship effectively one-to-one from the history record to this subtype. A manager can be associated with many task history subtype rows over time for audit and activity tracing.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced task history record's {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_id
foreignFields.description: Manager actor who performed the status change. {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subtype link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subtype link was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion when this subtype link is no longer active.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_of_employees
models.description:
Employee subtype ownership record for a task history entry.

This table implements the normalized polymorphic actor pattern for {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories} when the status change was performed by an {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} actor. Each record belongs to exactly one task history entry and exactly one employee account, allowing the parent history table to avoid multiple nullable actor foreign keys while preserving clear audit ownership.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_history_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task history record. {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee actor who performed the task status change. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee task-history subtype record was created.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timers
models.description:
Live running timers for employees before they are converted into finalized timelog entries.

Each record represents the employee's current active timer within one organization context, linked to the selected project and optionally to a task in that project. The timer stores mutable working notes while it is running and persists until the employee stops it to create a timelog or discards it without conversion.

This table keeps only operational live-timer state and avoids storing calculated duration or denormalized project, task, or employee details. It references {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}, and optionally {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this running timer. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who currently owns and runs this timer. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project selected for the running timer. {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task selected for the running timer. {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer started running.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional mutable work note describing what the employee is currently doing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for discarded or otherwise removed timer records.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timelogs
models.description:
Historical time entries recorded by employees within an organization.

This table stores raw time tracking records for work performed on a specific date, including the employee who logged the time, the organization context, the related project, and an optional task. It preserves transactional work history used by weekly timesheets, reporting, dashboards, and audit-oriented lifecycle rules.

Timelogs remain as historical records even when an employee is deactivated or a project later changes lifecycle state. Inclusion in a timesheet is managed through a separate normalized association table rather than a direct nullable foreign key on this model. Related entities include {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}, and {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context that owns this timelog. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who logged this time entry. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project to which the logged work belongs. {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task within the selected project that this work entry relates to. {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

plainFields.name: worked_on
plainFields.description: Calendar date for which the time was logged.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Recorded work duration in whole minutes for this timelog entry.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional employee-entered note describing what work was performed.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether the logged time is billable. Default behavior is true at the application layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this timelog record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this timelog record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this timelog record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly timesheet records owned by an organization employee for a Monday-to-Sunday reporting period.

This table stores the workflow state of a timesheet, including draft, submission, approval, rejection, and review timestamps, while the included timelogs are normalized through {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_timelogs}. It belongs to one organization and one workforce employee record so all access remains organization-scoped.

Calculated totals such as total hours are intentionally not stored in this regular table and should be derived from linked timelog records. Historical approval and rejection trail preservation is handled by {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_snapshots}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context of this timesheet. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timesheet. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start datetime of the reporting week for this timesheet, representing the Monday boundary of the covered week.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End datetime of the reporting week for this timesheet, representing the Sunday boundary of the covered week.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Workflow status of the timesheet. Allowed business values are draft, submitted, approved, and rejected.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee submitted the timesheet for approval.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the submitted timesheet was approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when a submitted timesheet is rejected. It must be present only for rejected workflow outcomes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means the timesheet remains active in the system.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_timelogs
models.description:
Explicit inclusion records that attach individual timelogs to a weekly timesheet.

This subsidiary table normalizes the timesheet composition workflow by storing one row for each timelog included in a specific {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets}. It supports draft timesheet add and remove operations without storing arrays or denormalized aggregates on the parent timesheet.

Each included {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs} can belong to at most one timesheet at a time, which preserves the business rule that a timelog is included in one weekly submission context. Historical locking and approval audit behavior is handled by the parent timesheet and snapshot workflow rather than duplicating status data here.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Included timesheet's {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Included timelog's {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this timelog was added to the timesheet composition.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this inclusion record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this inclusion record was soft deleted after being removed from a draft timesheet.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time child snapshot records for timesheets.

This table stores snapshot-specific state that belongs to a historical capture event for one source timesheet in {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets}. It is intentionally normalized to avoid duplicating fields that already exist on the parent timesheet row and should be accessed through the parent relationship.

Each snapshot record preserves whether the timesheet was locked at the time of capture, supporting workflow audit interpretation without introducing redundant copies of parent timesheet attributes.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Source timesheet's {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id}.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: Whether the source timesheet was locked against modification at the moment this snapshot record was captured.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs
models.description:
Organization-scoped audit trail entries for significant business actions.

This table records append-oriented activity events such as employee invitations, contract changes, project lifecycle changes, task status changes, timesheet review actions, and role assignment changes within one organization. Each entry stores the common event payload, identifies the actor category that performed the action, and preserves generic target entity references so the audit trail can cover multiple business domains without denormalizing source records.

The table belongs to one organization through {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}. Actor-specific ownership is intentionally normalized through dedicated subtype tables rather than multiple nullable foreign keys on this model, enabling strict polymorphic linkage for owner, manager, and employee actors while keeping this main audit record reusable across all action categories.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this audit entry. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Category of authenticated actor who performed the action, such as owner, manager, or employee.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Business action classification recorded by the audit trail, such as employee_invited, timesheet_approved, or project_archived.

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Business entity type affected by the action, such as employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, or role.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the affected target record when the audited action points to a specific persisted entity.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Human-readable structured detail text describing the action context, notable field changes, or review rationale.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audited action occurred and the log entry was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit log record was last updated by internal maintenance processes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the audit log entry when hidden from active browsing without physical removal.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_reports
models.description:
Saved organization-scoped report definitions for reusable analytical views.

This table stores the stable configuration of a report, such as its report family, optional date scope, grouping mode, and single-value filter toggles. It belongs to one organization through {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id} and acts as the parent definition for generated historical outputs in {@link hrm_time_tracking_report_snapshots}.

The model intentionally stores only atomic configuration fields. Repeating filter selections such as multiple employees, projects, or tasks are normalized into child tables so report definitions remain in Third Normal Form and can be reused consistently over time.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Owning organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the saved report definition.

plainFields.name: report_type
plainFields.description: Type of saved report definition, such as time_report, project_budget_report, or weekly_summary_report.

plainFields.name: range_start_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive start of the saved reporting period when the report is constrained by a date range.

plainFields.name: range_end_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive end of the saved reporting period when the report is constrained by a date range.

plainFields.name: group_by
plainFields.description: Grouping dimension used by grouped reports, such as employee, project, task, or week.

plainFields.name: billable_only
plainFields.description: Whether the saved report filters results to billable records only.

plainFields.name: include_non_billable
plainFields.description: Whether non-billable records are included when the report supports billable breakdowns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this saved report definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this saved report definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this saved report definition was soft deleted.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time persisted outputs of generated reports.

Each record captures an immutable generated artifact for one saved report definition in {@link hrm_time_tracking_reports}, allowing historical report results to remain reproducible even after underlying operational data changes. The table stores output metadata, covered reporting period boundaries, and generation timing rather than duplicating source business data.

This model is designed as an append-oriented historical store for analytical artifacts. Multiple snapshots may exist for the same report over time, supporting report history, auditability, and later retrieval of previously generated outputs.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_id
foreignFields.description: Saved report definition's {@link hrm_time_tracking_reports.id}.

plainFields.name: output_uri
plainFields.description: Stored location of the generated report artifact for later retrieval.

plainFields.name: output_format
plainFields.description: Serialization or export format of the generated report artifact, such as csv, xlsx, or pdf.

plainFields.name: period_start
plainFields.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the reporting period covered by this generated snapshot.

plainFields.name: period_end
plainFields.description: Inclusive end timestamp of the reporting period covered by this generated snapshot.

plainFields.name: row_count
plainFields.description: Number of result rows contained in the generated report output when the format exposes tabular rows.

plainFields.name: generated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report output was generated and persisted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot metadata was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the snapshot record when it is removed from active visibility.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_weekly_summaries
models.description:
Derived weekly organization summary records for dashboard and reporting use.

Each record stores precomputed organization-scoped metrics for a single Monday-to-Sunday week, such as total logged hours, pending timesheet count, active employee count, and project budget alert count. The table belongs to {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations} and supports efficient retrieval of weekly insight data without denormalizing detailed transactional rows from timelogs, timesheets, employees, or projects.

This table is a system-managed analytical support structure rather than a user-managed operational entity. It preserves historical weekly aggregates even as underlying operational data evolves, which helps keep dashboard and report outputs reproducible for prior weeks.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization owning this weekly summary record. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the summarized week, aligned to Monday in the organization's reporting context.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive end timestamp of the summarized week, aligned to Sunday in the organization's reporting context.

plainFields.name: total_logged_hours
plainFields.description: Total hours logged across the organization during the summarized week.

plainFields.name: pending_timesheet_count
plainFields.description: Number of submitted timesheets in the organization that are still awaiting approval for the summarized week.

plainFields.name: active_employee_count
plainFields.description: Number of active employees in the organization during the summarized week.

plainFields.name: budget_alert_count
plainFields.description: Number of projects whose budget utilization exceeded the dashboard alert threshold during the summarized week.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this weekly summary record was first generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this weekly summary record was last refreshed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this weekly summary record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_weekly_summaries
models.description:
Derived weekly summary record for one employee.

This table persists dashboard-oriented weekly aggregates and status snapshots for a Monday-to-Sunday period, such as total time logged, current timesheet state, active timer presence, and assigned task counts. It references the owning employee and avoids duplicating parent employee attributes that can be resolved through {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees}.

The record is intended for efficient employee dashboard retrieval and weekly insight queries in the Insights component. Values are recalculated from operational tables and should be treated as derived summary data rather than authoritative workflow state.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee whose weekly dashboard summary is represented. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the summary week, aligned to Monday in the employee's organization business calendar.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: Inclusive end timestamp of the summary week, aligned to Sunday in the employee's organization business calendar.

plainFields.name: total_minutes_logged
plainFields.description: Total minutes logged by the employee during the summarized week across included timelogs.

plainFields.name: current_timesheet_status
plainFields.description: Current timesheet status for the summarized week when a weekly timesheet exists, such as draft, submitted, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: active_timer_running
plainFields.description: Whether the employee has an active running timer at the moment this summary row was last refreshed.

plainFields.name: assigned_open_task_count
plainFields.description: Number of open tasks assigned to the employee that are relevant to the dashboard during the summarized week.

plainFields.name: assigned_in_progress_task_count
plainFields.description: Number of in-progress tasks assigned to the employee that are relevant to the dashboard during the summarized week.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this derived summary record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this derived summary record was last refreshed from source operational data.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for lifecycle control when a derived summary record is retired.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_budget_alerts
models.description:
Derived budget alert records for organization dashboard insight.

Each record captures a project's budget-consumption state for a specific weekly summary window so dashboard queries can quickly identify projects whose logged hours have crossed an alert threshold such as 80 percent. The table references the owning organization and project without duplicating project master data, preserving normalization while supporting reproducible historical dashboard views.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Owning organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Alerted project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date and time of the summarized week window represented by this alert record.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date and time of the summarized week window represented by this alert record.

plainFields.name: actual_hours
plainFields.description: Actual accumulated logged hours considered in the budget-consumption calculation for this alert record.

plainFields.name: utilization_rate
plainFields.description: Computed ratio of actual hours to the project's configured budget hours for this alert record.

plainFields.name: threshold_rate
plainFields.description: Alert threshold ratio applied when determining whether the project should appear in the dashboard alert set.

plainFields.name: is_alert
plainFields.description: Whether the project met or exceeded the configured alert threshold for this summary window.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_of_owners
models.description:
Normalized owner-actor subtype for activity log entries.

This table links one {@link hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs} record to the {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners} account that performed the logged action when the actor type is owner. It implements the required polymorphic actor ownership pattern in normalized form, avoiding multiple nullable actor foreign keys on the parent activity log.

Each row represents exactly one owner-backed attribution for one activity log entry and is managed as a dependent record of the parent audit event.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced activity log entry. {@link hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner account that performed the logged action. {@link hrm_time_tracking_owners.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this owner attribution record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this owner attribution record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this owner attribution record.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_of_managers
models.description:
Normalized manager-actor subtype for an activity log entry.

This table links one {@link hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs} record to the manager account in {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers} that performed the logged action. It exists to preserve normalized polymorphic actor ownership for activity logs without placing multiple nullable actor foreign keys on the parent audit table.

Each row belongs to exactly one activity log entry and exactly one manager account. The activity log reference is unique so an activity log can have at most one manager subtype row in this ownership branch.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced activity log entry. {@link hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_manager_id
foreignFields.description: Manager account that performed the logged action. {@link hrm_time_tracking_managers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this manager activity-log ownership link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this manager activity-log ownership link was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this manager activity-log ownership link.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_of_employees
models.description:
Subtype table linking an activity log entry to the employee actor account that performed the recorded action.

This table implements the normalized polymorphic actor pattern for {@link hrm_time_tracking_activity_logs} by storing the employee-specific ownership branch in a separate dependent record instead of using multiple nullable actor foreign keys on the parent activity log.

Each row belongs to exactly one activity log entry and one employee actor account from {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees}. The unique link to the activity log enforces that a given log entry can have at most one employee-actor subtype record.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_id

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee actor account that performed the logged action. {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee-actor subtype link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee-actor subtype link was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the subtype link when it is logically removed.

Normalized employee filter selections attached to a saved report definition.

This table references the organization-scoped workforce entity {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} and is managed through its parent report rather than as an independently administered business object.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_id
foreignFields.description: Saved report definition's {@link hrm_time_tracking_reports.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Selected employee filter's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_project_filters
models.description:
Normalized project filter selections for a saved report definition.

Each row links one saved report in {@link hrm_time_tracking_reports} to one selected project in {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects}, allowing reports to persist multi-project filtering without storing arrays or serialized values. This table is organization-scoped indirectly through its parent report and preserves normalized analytical filter configuration for reproducible reporting.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_id
foreignFields.description: Saved report definition's {@link hrm_time_tracking_reports.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Selected project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_report_task_filters

Normalized task filter selections attached to a saved report definition.
